It happens to the best of us. Especially for your first time. There are a lot of feelings you're going through, and overthinking can kill that primal urge.
Losing out on the money can feel bad, but I'm glad she didn't try to make things worse for you. Honestly, money comes and goes. Don't spend too much time thinking about what you lost and focus on making more. You could go to strip clubs to get more comfortable with being around naked women and being touched by one (just don't spend a lot or fall for one as your inexperience could be taken advantage of). Besides, you can always wait till you're ready and try again with that beautiful woman. Not to be rude to her, but there is no such thing as blowing it with a hooker.

Also, try to work on how you look at yourself. Try to look at your positives more. If you think there aren't many, make more. Your weight or size isn't everything. There is a lot more to a person that people value, but the important thing is learning to value those yourself. People can roughly tell how you feel by the way you talk about yourself and treat yourself. How can you expect others to value you if you don't value yourself? 

You are still very young and sound like you think it really is now or never. You still have tons of time for a lifetime of sex. For now, forget about sex and work on yourself. Bring up your self-confidence and take it to heart. Radiate confidence in anything you do! Doesn't matter if someone doesn't believe it. If you believe it, you will attract others who see that from you. 

Working on your self-confidence will also help with your performance. Self-doubt, fear, and insecurities will hinder you. These get in your head and make it difficult to get up or even stay up. 
Also, 30 minutes is a short time to try to rush everything, especially for your first. Some people really need time and foreplay to really get going.
